x: We were well placed at the start, and after about a mile and a half Hines, of Surrey, was leading, followed by Belton (Surrey), Thorogood (Mitcham), with about nine of ours in the first thirty.
The 1 Mile team race provided the large crowd with a big thrill; Les Cohen and Thorogood, the A.A.A. Indoor 2 Mile Champion, having a ding-dong battle over the last 200 yds.
Mitcham were also now in front of Birchfield in the team race and the four Welsh members of their scoring six all ran well to assist Thorogood and Brickwood in gaining team honours.
